prompt_instructions: Attach the finished-dish reference for faithful food styling.
The original source includes three recipe variants; use one approved recipe per rendered card, while preserving the same reusable layout system.
Set final recipe text in post-production for exact legibility.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Minimalist modern recipe infographic. Photography style: Top-down / 3-quarter angle food photography. Design language: Scandinavian, editorial cookbook layout. Background: soft neutral beige / cream. Lighting: soft diffused light with gentle shadows. Detail level: ultra-realistic, ultra-sharp, 8K resolution. Finished dish centered on a white ceramic plate or bowl. Include floating ingredient icons in soft circular frames, clean vector-style ingredient illustrations, clear ingredient labels with quantities, and a curved step-by-step flow with numbered cooking icons. Use high-readability modern sans-serif typography with balanced, airy, uncluttered spacing. Recipes: Traditional Polish Pierogi, golden boiled dumplings filled with potato and cheese, lightly buttered and garnished with fresh chives; ingredients all-purpose flour 2.5 cups, potatoes 3 medium, farmer cheese 200g, onion 1 medium, butter 40g, salt 1 tsp, water 0.75 cups; steps Prepare dough, Cook and mash filling, Fill and shape pierogi, Boil until tender, Serve with butter; 270 kcal / serving, 70 min, serves 4. Vinaigrette Salad, colorful diced vegetables with light dressing and fresh herbs; ingredients beetroot 2 medium, potatoes 2 medium, carrots 1 medium, pickled cucumbers 2 pcs, green peas 1 cup, sunflower oil 2 tbsp, fresh dill 1 bunch; steps Boil vegetables, Cool and dice, Mix ingredients, Dress salad, Chill and serve; 180 kcal / serving, 30 min + chill, serves 4. Solyanka Soup, rich hearty soup with sliced meats, olives, lemon, and herbs in a steaming ceramic bowl; ingredients mixed meats 400g, onion 1 large, pickles 3 pcs, tomato paste 2 tbsp, olives 1/2 cup, garlic 2 cloves, bay leaf 1 pc, lemon for serving; steps Simmer broth, Sauté aromatics, Add meats and pickles, Season and simmer, Serve with lemon; 320 kcal / serving, 90 min, serves 5.
